status: approved source implementation; actual renderer qualification still required

container.trustedHost: Author-code-free top main frame is sole native bridge; never raw interpolate author bytes into trusted script or attributes. Use safe parameter serialization.
container.authorFrame: Host-owned iframe sandbox=allow-scripts only; no allow-same-origin, top navigation, forms, popups or downloads.
container.permissionsPolicy: geolocation 'none'; camera 'none'; microphone 'none'; display-capture 'none'; clipboard-read 'none'; clipboard-write 'none'; fullscreen 'none'
container.bridge: Parent accepts closed requests only from exact current iframe.contentWindow with opaque origin null; native rechecks actual WK/main-frame identity, captured namespace, view revision, generation and Core ACL. Child direct native calls and nested frames rejected. No generic Core RPC or JS-supplied identity/grant.
container.revocation: Navigation, frame reload, crash, namespace or code change revokes bridge and late asynchronous results. WindowProxy/origin-null alone is insufficient evidence.
container.failure: Unknown policy/eligibility fails closed to unsupported code execution; native data/documents remain usable.

platform.ios17Through18_3: Code views may be stored/edited but not executed; native knowledge/docs/RPC continue.
platform.codeEligibilityMinimum: iOS18.4 public WKUIDelegate runOpenPanel callback with explicit denial; no private APIs, JS removal substitutes, or OS permission bypass.
platform.evidence: Actual local iPhoneOS SDK WKUIDelegate.h lines291-295: iOS without delegate matches Safari; callback available iOS18.4. Geolocation denial delegate is iOS27-only, so older systems require independently qualified origin/permissions policy.
platform.qualification: Source/DI checks do not prove actual WebKit isolation. Full authorized renderer flow must prove file/network/media/location/clipboard/navigation and late-result boundaries.

controlPlane: Ordinary scoped knowledge Apply only under native host grant. Initialize, branch, merge, restore, Unknown resolution and grant changes require genuine native Human action; synthetic JS clicks or acknowledge=true do not qualify.
authorization: No new App/OS-permission probe, installation, real provider or daily-data action authorized by this design decision.
